rule: Highest priority is resected or MRD-positive low-burden disease, not bulky metastatic disease
disposition: GO if post-operative/MRD window; TRIAL-FIRST if measurable metastatic
failure_mode: High tumor burden and suppressive TME can outpace vaccine priming

measurement: KRAS mutation plus WES/RNA neoantigen load
rule: KRAS G12D/R/V/S/A/C or G13D supports shared/public vaccine; enough private class I/II neoantigens supports personalized vaccine
failure_mode: Low neoantigen count or no recurrent driver target makes vaccine weak

measurement: HLA typing, HLA LOH, B2M, HLA-A/B/C expression, antigen-processing genes
rule: Require at least one strong-presenting allele and no obvious antigen-presentation escape
disposition: GO if HLA intact; NO-GO/alternate if HLA LOH or B2M loss
failure_mode: Good peptide predictions fail if tumor cannot present antigen

measurement: ALC, steroids/immunosuppression, autoimmune history, prior chemo recovery
rule: Fit patients with recoverable lymphocytes and no major immunosuppression score higher
disposition: GO if ECOG 0-1 and immune competent
failure_mode: T-cell expansion is the drug; immunosuppression blocks mechanism

rule: Require early pharmacodynamic readout; lack of T-cell induction should trigger pivot
disposition: CONTINUE only with immune response or biomarker stabilization
failure_mode: Delayed clinical endpoints hide early vaccine failure

measurement: histology, stage, RAI-refractory status, ATC/PDTC transformation
rule: Vaccine strategies should focus on ATC, PDTC, progressive RAI-refractory DTC, or high-risk recurrence; not routine low-risk PTC
failure_mode: Most PTC is cured with standard care; vaccine risk/complexity unjustified

measurement: BRAF V600E, RET/NTRK fusion, RAS, TERT, MAPK score
rule: BRAF V600E ATC uses BRAF/MEK backbone; non-BRAF ATC/DTC uses TKI/VEGF+PD-1 trial logic
failure_mode: Vaccine alone is too slow for ATC and too weak for immune-cold DTC

measurement: HT status, TLS/B-cell module, IFNG/HLA-II, CD8, PD-L1, myeloid score
rule: Prioritize HT/TLS/IFN/HLA-II active tumors and ATC/RAI-dediff immune axis with antigen presentation intact
disposition: GO if immune-active; ABSTAIN if cold and HLA-low
failure_mode: Low TMB plus immune-cold state gives too little substrate and priming

measurement: HLA-A*24:02/A*02:01/A*11:01/B alleles; arcasHLA or WES HLA typing
rule: Korean translation must not assume A*02:01/A*11:01 dominance; A*24:02 needs allele-specific candidates
disposition: GO if allele-specific peptide model supports target
failure_mode: Western HLA-biased peptide panels can miss Korean patients

measurement: Hashimoto/GD, thyroid autoantibodies, steroid need, organ autoimmunity
rule: HT/TLS may enrich immunity but also raises checkpoint-autoimmunity caution
disposition: GO with monitoring; TRIAL-FIRST if active autoimmune disease

measurement: tissue adequacy, normal comparator, WES/RNA QC, turnaround
rule: Personalized vaccine needs enough viable tissue, paired normal, RNA expression, and fast manufacturing
disposition: GO if all inputs available within therapeutic window
failure_mode: Late sequencing or poor tissue turns the strategy academic only

measurement: CLEAN-Neo or equivalent: binding, expression, WT-mut delta, clonality, class I/II, uncertainty
rule: Rank by clonal expressed target, intact presentation, low WT similarity, class I+II helper balance, calibrated uncertainty
disposition: GO if top candidates pass threshold; ABSTAIN if model uncertain/high OOD
